# Saved wire frames

These are the exact JSON text a peer session decrypts before `serde_json`
reads it, hand-composed against a real value, never generated by asking this
build to serialize one and saving the output.

They are never regenerated. A fixture rewritten to match today's code proves
that today's code agrees with itself, which is nothing: the whole point is
that these bytes stay frozen at whatever an old build actually wrote, so a
later build is proven against a real past frame and not against its own
memory of one.

Adding a message type: hand-write two fixtures for it (every optional field
populated, and every optional field absent) straight from the type's own
`Serialize` derive and field names, add the matching assertions to
`tests/peer_wire_saved.rs`, and leave every existing fixture in this
directory untouched.
